name: done true appends trimmed action
spec_quote: append {"on": today, "action": <action_needed trimmed>} to the row's action_done list; set action_needed = "", updated = today.

name: done true with action_needed missing
expect_error: no open action on this row
spec_quote: no open action → return (the unchanged row, "no open action on this row").

name: done true with empty action_needed
expect_error: no open action on this row
spec_quote: "No open action" = action_needed missing, empty / only spaces, or exactly "等结果" (after trimming).

name: done true with spaces-only action_needed
expect_error: no open action on this row
spec_quote: "No open action" = action_needed missing, empty / only spaces, or exactly "等结果" (after trimming).

name: done true with 等结果 plus spaces
expect_error: no open action on this row
spec_quote: "No open action" = action_needed missing, empty / only spaces, or exactly "等结果" (after trimming).

name: done true appends to existing history
spec_quote: append {"on": today, "action": <action_needed trimmed>} to the row's action_done list (create it if missing; keep older entries in order).

name: done true keeps other fields unchanged
spec_quote: No other field changes.

name: undo removes last entry and deletes empty action_done
spec_quote: remove the LAST entry of action_done and put its "action" back into action_needed; updated = today; if the list is now empty, the action_done key is removed entirely.

name: undo with multiple entries restores last only
spec_quote: remove the LAST entry of action_done and put its "action" back into action_needed.

name: undo with no action_done list
spec_quote: no action_done list or an empty one → (unchanged row, "nothing to undo").

name: undo with empty action_done list
spec_quote: no action_done list or an empty one → (unchanged row, "nothing to undo").

name: undo blocked by new open action
expect_error: the row has a new action since; nothing undone
spec_quote: the row has an open action → (unchanged row, "the row has a new action since; nothing undone").

name: undo allowed when action_needed is 等结果
spec_quote: "No open action" = action_needed missing, empty / only spaces, or exactly "等结果" (after trimming).

name: undo allowed when action_needed is spaces-only
spec_quote: "No open action" = action_needed missing, empty / only spaces, or exactly "等结果" (after trimming).

name: validate bad Host header 421
ambiguous_reason: Spec gives only the status code, not the error payload keys.
spec_quote: Host header must be localhost or 127.0.0.1 (optional :port) else 421

name: validate bad path 404
ambiguous_reason: Spec gives only the status code, not the error payload keys.
spec_quote: path (query string ignored) must be /pref or /action else 404

name: validate GET method 405
ambiguous_reason: Spec gives only the status code, not the error payload keys.
spec_quote: method must be POST else 405

name: validate bad Origin 403
ambiguous_reason: Spec gives only the status code, not the error payload keys.
spec_quote: Origin header absent, "null", or http://localhost[:port] / http://127.0.0.1[:port] else 403

name: validate bad x-jsa-pref 403
ambiguous_reason: Spec gives only the status code, not the error payload keys.
spec_quote: header x-jsa-pref must be exactly "1" else 403

name: validate non-json content-type 415
ambiguous_reason: Spec gives only the status code, not the error payload keys.
spec_quote: content-type must start with application/json (case-insensitive) else 415

name: validate invalid JSON body 400
ambiguous_reason: Spec gives only the status code, not the error payload keys.
spec_quote: body not JSON → 400

name: validate extra key 400
ambiguous_reason: Spec gives only the status code, not the error payload keys.
spec_quote: the JSON must be an object with exactly the keys job_id and done, else 400

name: validate bad job_id 400
ambiguous_reason: Spec gives only the status code, not the error payload keys.
spec_quote: job_id must be a string "J" + 4 to 6 digits, else 400

name: validate done as number 400
ambiguous_reason: Spec gives only the status code, not the error payload keys.
spec_quote: done must be a JSON boolean (not 0/1, not "true"), else 400

name: validate success with query string and case-insensitive content-type
spec_quote: Success → (200, {"route": "/action", "job_id": <job_id>, "done": <done>}).
